automation_evidence.quote:
Through curated exploratory data analysis, a diverse change-point detection
model bank, and validation-guided trajectory evolution, the agent
automatically selects, refines, and synthesizes detection pipelines.

metric_evidence.quote:
The complete
EvoTS-Agent achieves the highest F1 score of 0.635, compared with
0.578 without Alternative Strategy and 0.575 without Recombination.

evidence.quote:
Ground-truth change points
and test-set metrics are excluded to prevent information leakage.

summary: Automates change-point detector selection, tuning and synthesis with validation-guided trajectory evolution; it beats TS-Agent, DS-Agent and ResearchAgent on F1 across four datasets and four backbones with 100% execution success, and ablates the operators, but tests no time series obstacle.
